plan.businessDomain: Hiring pipeline: job positions opened by recruiters, candidates and their applications moving through screening, interview, offer, hired or rejected, with the position closing automatically when its headcount is filled.

entities.title: Candidate
entities.description: A person who applies to job positions. The name is the platform record; the e-mail is a linked contact channel; the resume link and the source of the candidate are kept in the module namespace. An existing person is reused instead of duplicated.

entities.title: Candidate e-mail
entities.description: The e-mail address of a candidate, kept as a contact channel record linked to the candidate and used to find an existing candidate.

entities.title: Hiring Manager
entities.description: The person who manages a job position and decides offers and hires for its applications. Her positions and their applications are scoped to her through the position's hiring manager.

entities.title: Job Position
entities.description: An opening published by a recruiter with title, department, description, headcount and hiring manager. It is open while hires are below the headcount and closes automatically when the headcount is filled; hires so far and remaining openings are derived from its applications.

entities.title: Application
entities.description: A candidate's application to a job position, moving through the stages screening, interview, offer, then hired or rejected with a rejection reason.

relationships.description: Each job position has one hiring manager who decides offers and hires for it.
Each application is made to one job position.
Each application belongs to one candidate.
The candidate's e-mail address is a contact channel linked to the candidate.
The job positions a candidate has applied to, read through the candidate's applications.

entities.title: Candidate
entities.description: A person who applies to job positions. The name is the platform record; the e-mail is a linked contact channel; the resume link and the source of the candidate are kept in the module namespace. An existing person is reused instead of duplicated.

applications.title: Applications
applications.description: The applications this candidate has made to job positions.

emails.title: E-mail
emails.description: The candidate's e-mail address, a contact channel linked by HasContact.

positions.title: Positions applied to
positions.description: The job positions the candidate applied to, read through the applications.

capabilities.read.byId: Loads the candidate by id so the recruiter and the hiring manager see name, e-mail, resume link and source on an application.
capabilities.locate.byName: The recruiter searches candidates by name before registering, to reuse an existing one.
capabilities.locate.byContact: The recruiter finds an existing candidate by e-mail during registration, so the same person is not duplicated.
capabilities.locate.byDocument: When a national document is known, the recruiter finds the candidate by it to deduplicate.
capabilities.register.createOrAttach: The recruiter registers a candidate: the person is reused when found by document or e-mail, created otherwise, and tagged hiringPipeline.Candidate.
capabilities.edit.platformFields: The recruiter corrects the candidate's name, aliases or privacy consent.
capabilities.edit.moduleNamespace: The recruiter updates the candidate's resume link and source.
capabilities.link.contact: The recruiter records the candidate's e-mail as a contact channel linked with HasContact.
capabilities.listLinks: The candidate screen lists the candidate's e-mail and linked records.
capabilities.inactivate: The recruiter inactivates a candidate who should no longer be considered, keeping the history; it can be reactivated.
capabilities.attach.document: The recruiter stores a resume file or other document against the candidate when it is not a published link.
capabilities.comment: Recruiters and hiring managers leave notes about the candidate.
capabilities.tag: The recruiter labels candidates (for example by skill) inside the hiringPipeline namespace.
capabilities.statusHistory.read: Shows when the candidate record was inactivated or reactivated, and by whom.
capabilities.audit: Shows who changed the candidate's data and when.

candidate.title: Candidate who owns this e-mail
candidate.description: HasContact link from the candidate to this e-mail record.

capabilities.read.byId: Reads the candidate's e-mail record by id when the candidate screen shows its contacts; used by recruiters and hiring managers.
capabilities.locate.byContact: Finds the candidate who already owns a typed e-mail address, so the recruiter does not register the same candidate twice.
capabilities.register.createOrAttach: Creates the e-mail record when the address is new, or attaches the hiringPipeline role to the existing one, when the recruiter registers a candidate.
capabilities.edit.platformFields: Lets the recruiter correct the candidate's e-mail address or its verification flag.
capabilities.inactivate: Takes an e-mail address the candidate no longer uses out of use without deleting it; the recruiter can reactivate it.
capabilities.link: Links the e-mail record to its candidate with HasContact when the recruiter registers the candidate.
capabilities.unlink: Closes the HasContact link when the address no longer belongs to the candidate, keeping its history.
capabilities.listLinks: Shows which candidate the e-mail belongs to, on the candidate screen.
capabilities.audit: Shows who changed the candidate's e-mail address and when.

entities.title: Hiring Manager
entities.description: The person who manages a job position and decides offers and hires for its applications. Her positions and their applications are scoped to her through the position's hiring manager.

jobPositions.title: Managed job positions
jobPositions.description: The job positions this person manages; each position has exactly one hiring manager, and her positions and their applications are scoped to her through it.

capabilities.read.byId: Reads the hiring manager by mdmId to show her name on job positions and applications, for recruiters and hiring managers.
capabilities.locate.byName: Finds a hiring manager by typed name when a recruiter assigns the manager of a job position.
capabilities.locate.byLogin: Resolves the signed-in hiring manager from her login e-mail so her positions and applications are scoped to her.
capabilities.register.createOrAttach: Creates the person when absent and attaches the hiringPipeline.HiringManager role, when a recruiter names a manager for a position.
capabilities.edit.platformFields: Lets a recruiter correct the hiring manager's name and other platform fields.
capabilities.inactivate: Takes a hiring manager out of use so she is no longer offered for new positions, and reactivates her when needed; used by recruiters.
capabilities.link.contact: Adds an e-mail or phone of the hiring manager as a ContactChannel linked by HasContact, maintained by recruiters.
capabilities.listLinks: Shows the hiring manager's level-1 relationships and contacts on her record screen.
capabilities.invite.login: Gives the hiring manager a login so she can decide offers and hires on her own positions; issued by a recruiter.
capabilities.comment: Lets recruiters leave notes on the hiring manager's record.
capabilities.audit: Shows who changed the hiring manager's record and when, for an administrator.

entities.title: Job Position
entities.description: An opening published by a recruiter with title, department, description, headcount and hiring manager. It is open while hires are below the headcount and closes automatically when the headcount is filled; hires so far and remaining openings are derived from its applications.

hiringManager.title: Hiring manager
hiringManager.description: The hiring manager who owns the position and decides offers and hires for it.

applications.title: Applications
applications.description: The applications candidates have made to this position.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: The candidates who applied to this position, found through its applications.

capabilities.read.byId: Opens one job position by its id, so the recruiter can review the position she just opened and the hiring manager can inspect it while deciding a hire.
capabilities.locate.byColumn: Lists positions filtered by status, department or hiring manager and sorted by opening date. The recruiter uses it to find open positions; the hiring manager uses it to list the positions she manages.
capabilities.locate.byText: Searches positions by part of the title or department, so the recruiter can find the open position a candidate is applying to.
capabilities.count: Counts the positions that match a filter, such as open positions per department or per hiring manager, for list headers.
capabilities.listByForeignKey: Lists every position of one hiring manager by hiringManagerId. This is what fills the hiring manager's pipeline view.
capabilities.create: The recruiter opens a new position with its title, department, description, headcount and hiring manager, and it starts as open.
capabilities.update: The recruiter corrects the title, department, description, headcount or hiring manager of a position.
capabilities.transition: The application pipeline moves a position from open to closed once its headcount is filled. The guard for this lives in the module.
capabilities.transaction: Writes the hire of an application and the closing of its position together, all or nothing, when that hire fills the headcount.
capabilities.read.mdmRecord: Reads the hiring manager's master record that hiringManagerId points at, so position screens can show her name.
capabilities.comment: Lets the recruiter and the hiring manager leave notes about a position.

title.title: Title
title.description: Title of the job position. Recruiters and hiring managers search and sort positions by it.

department.title: Department
department.description: Department the position belongs to. Position lists are filtered by it.

hiringManagerId.title: Hiring manager
hiringManagerId.description: The hiring manager who decides offers and hires for this position. Her 'my positions' lists use this key.

values.title: Open
values.description: Taking applications. Hires are still below the headcount.

values.title: Closed
values.description: The headcount is filled, so no new applications are taken.

status.title: Status
status.description: Whether the position is still taking candidates. It opens when the recruiter creates it and closes automatically once the headcount is filled.

openedAt.title: Opened at
openedAt.description: When the recruiter opened the position. Written by the system when the position is created, and used to sort position lists.

details.title: Details
details.description: Everything else about the position that nobody filters by.

description.title: Description
description.description: Full description of the job: responsibilities, requirements and context.

headcount.title: Headcount
headcount.description: How many people this position will hire. The position closes automatically once this many applications have reached hired.

hiresSoFar.title: Hires so far
hiresSoFar.description: Number of applications to this position that have reached the hired stage.

remainingOpenings.title: Remaining openings
remainingOpenings.description: The position's headcount minus its hires so far, never less than zero.

headcountFilled.title: Headcount filled
headcountFilled.description: True when the hires so far are equal to or greater than the position's headcount.

transitions.description: The application pipeline closes the position automatically as soon as hires reach the headcount. No person makes this move.

entities.title: Application
entities.description: A candidate's application to a job position, moving through the stages screening, interview, offer, then hired or rejected with a rejection reason.

jobPosition.title: Job position applied to
jobPosition.description: Each application is made to one job position.

candidate.title: Applying candidate
candidate.description: Each application belongs to one candidate.

capabilities.read.byId: Opens one application by its id so the recruiter or the hiring manager can review it before acting.
capabilities.locate.byColumn: Lists applications filtered by stage, position or candidate and ordered by applied or stage-change date, for the recruiter's work queue and the hiring manager's pipeline of her positions.
capabilities.locate.byText: Finds an application by typing part of its application number in the search box of the recruiter's list.
capabilities.count: Counts applications per stage for a position, showing the hiring manager how her pipeline is distributed.
capabilities.listByForeignKey: Lists the applications of one job position or of one candidate, so a position screen shows its applicants grouped by stage and a candidate screen shows her applications.
capabilities.create: Records a candidate's application to an open position, starting in screening; used by the recruiter.
capabilities.update: Lets the recruiter correct the notes of an active application.
capabilities.transition: Moves the application between stages: the recruiter advances to interview or rejects with a reason, the hiring manager extends the offer and hires.
capabilities.uniqueKey: Refuses a second application of the same candidate to the same position and a repeated application number.
capabilities.transaction: Hires the candidate and closes the job position together when its headcount is filled, all or nothing.
capabilities.read.mdmRecord: Reads the candidate's name, email, resume link and source from the master record behind the candidate column, for every list and review screen.
capabilities.sequence.next: Issues the application number when the recruiter records the application.
capabilities.comment: Lets the recruiter and the hiring manager leave notes on the application while discussing interview and offer.
capabilities.statusHistory.read: Shows when the application changed stage and who moved it, for the review of its history by recruiter and hiring manager.

code.title: Application number
code.description: Number people quote to refer to the application, issued by the platform sequence when the application is recorded.

jobPositionId.title: Job position
jobPositionId.description: The job position the candidate applies to; it also defines the hiring manager who decides offer and hire.

candidateId.title: Candidate
candidateId.description: The candidate who applies; name, email, resume link and source are read from the candidate's master record.

status.title: Stage
status.description: Current stage of the application in the hiring pipeline.

appliedAt.title: Applied at
appliedAt.description: Moment the application was recorded; lists are ordered by it.

stageChangedAt.title: Stage changed at
stageChangedAt.description: Moment the application last entered its current stage; used to sort the pipeline and find stalled applications.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Free notes the recruiter records when registering or reviewing the application.

interview.title: Interview
interview.description: What happened when the application moved to interview.

movedAt.title: Moved to interview at
movedAt.description: Moment the recruiter moved the application to interview.

movedBy.title: Moved by
movedBy.description: The recruiter who moved the application to interview.

offer.title: Offer
offer.description: The offer extended by the hiring manager.

extendedAt.title: Offer extended at
extendedAt.description: Moment the hiring manager moved the application to offer.

decidedBy.title: Offer decided by
decidedBy.description: The hiring manager who extended the offer.

notes.title: Offer notes
notes.description: What the hiring manager wants recorded about the offer.

hiredAt.title: Hired at
hiredAt.description: Moment the hiring manager hired the candidate.

decidedBy.title: Hire decided by
decidedBy.description: The hiring manager who hired the candidate.

rejection.title: Rejection
rejection.description: Why and when the application was rejected; filled when it is rejected.

reason.title: Rejection reason
reason.description: The reason the application did not move forward, required to reject.

stageAtRejection.title: Stage at rejection
stageAtRejection.description: Stage the application was in when it was rejected.

isActive.title: Active
isActive.description: The application is still in screening, interview or offer, neither hired nor rejected.

daysInStage.title: Days in current stage
daysInStage.description: Number of days since the application entered its current stage, counted up to today.

remainingOpenings.title: Remaining openings of the position
remainingOpenings.description: Headcount of the application's job position minus the applications already hired for that position.

transitions.description: The recruiter moves a screened application to the interview stage.
The hiring manager of the position decides to extend an offer to the interviewed candidate.
The hiring manager of the position hires the candidate; when the position's headcount is filled the position closes automatically in the same operation.
The application is closed with a rejection reason; normally recorded by the recruiter, including when the hiring manager declines an offer or a hire and hands it back.

relationships.description: Each job position has one hiring manager who decides offers and hires for it.
Each application is made to one job position.
Each application belongs to one candidate.
The candidate's e-mail address is a contact channel linked to the candidate.
The job positions a candidate has applied to, read through the candidate's applications.
